en: Unaugmented and proud of it. Survives on wit and adaptability — flesh that refuses to become obsolete.

column3: half machine — all pragmatism. Whether by choice or necessity
column4: you've crossed the threshold most only dream about.

en: The city tried to kill you. It failed. You've made weapons from wreckage and learned the best tool is the one you have right now.
You didn't stop at practical. Every limb
column3: every organ — an opportunity for something harder. The flesh that remains is just scaffolding.

en: Composed under pressure. Lethal in formal wear. You've turned restraint into a weapon — your enemies don't see it coming until it's done.
Precision. Efficiency. You've outsourced instinct to systems that never panic. Your drone network sees what you don't.
You found something in the dark and it found you back. What others call ambition
column3: you call clarity. What they call madness
you synthesize. Arcane theory meets cybernetic precision. Your enemies can't prepare for what they can't categorize.

en: A battery-powered handheld light. Cuts a narrow beam through the dark.
A weathered canvas pack with reinforced straps. Expands what you can haul.
A layered belt with clip-loops for quick-access tools and injectors.
A snug cap with foam lining. Blunts a glancing blow.
A scuffed utility vest. Pockets for days.
Heavy at the head. Designed for plumbing; repurposed for convincing.
A small round shield someone beat into a pan and back again.
Thick leather palms. Your grip won't slip.
Reinforced toes. Good for long walks and short arguments.
A single-use trauma kit. Slow to use. Fast to matter.
I wish I had a light...
